hooks.name: Auto Push to GitHub after task

action.prompt:
After completing any coding task, always stage all modified files and push to GitHub using:
& "C:\Program Files\Git\cmd\git.exe" -C "i:\Kiro\truyen-next" add src/ .kiro/
& "C:\Program Files\Git\cmd\git.exe" -C "i:\Kiro\truyen-next" commit -m "auto: sync changes"
& "C:\Program Files\Git\cmd\git.exe" -C "i:\Kiro\truyen-next" push origin main

Only push if there are actual changes (git status shows modified/untracked files). Use a descriptive commit message based on what was done.
